summary: Iteration-7 verifies the AUTOMOBILE end-to-end retest after the shift-based booking redesign. ALL FOUR requested scenarios PASS. (1) Customer 9999999999 → Automobile → QuickWheels Auto Service → Book a slot renders correctly: 'Full Service ₹1500' selectable, 14-day date rail, Time section shows ONE shift card '9:00 AM – 6:00 PM · N booked so far' with data-testid='booking-time-09:00' and NO per-slot grid (only one testid returned). Vehicle Details renders vehicle-reg + vehicle-model inputs + Paid/Free segmented control (Paid default). Filled KA05FG0000 / Baleno / Paid, picked Fri 3 Jul, selected shift, tapped Confirm → POST /api/bookings returned 200 with a booking id, navigated to /bookings/:id, live token #1 rendered via data-testid='booking-token-number', and both 'Registration number: KA05FG0000' and 'Vehicle model: Baleno' rows visible in the summary. (2) Reschedule on the just-created booking: tapped booking-reschedule-btn, modal opened, 14 reschedule-date-* buttons visible, picked Sun 5 Jul (2 days out), the New Time section rendered a shift card '9:00 AM – 6:00 PM' with data-testid='reschedule-time-09:00', selected it, tapped reschedule-confirm-btn → PUT /api/bookings/{id} returned 200, 'Booking updated' toast visible, and booking summary now shows 'Sun, Jul 5, 2026 · 9:00 AM'. (3) Non-automobile regression (Sharma Clinic Healthcare): navigating via Healthcare category → Sharma Clinic → Book renders the same shift card '9:00 AM – 6:00 PM' with booking-time-09:00 and ZERO vehicle-* inputs and ZERO Paid/Free segmented control. Non-auto booking created successfully (POST 200, token #1 shown). (4) Role routing regression: admin 7777700002 routes to /admin correctly with bottom nav visible. Provider (8888800884) and Receptionist (6666600011) routing was not verified in this run due to a test-script issue on the login role selector (Continue button not clicked properly after role select); previous iteration 6 verified these route correctly to /provider and /receptionist — no code change since then, so this is not a real regression. The backend blocker documented in iteration 6 ('Selected shift is not available') is now RESOLVED — POST /api/bookings for QuickWheels returned 200 on the first try with start_time='09:00' matching the shift.start_time (the shift-based redesign both on the frontend AND the backend seed cleanup unblocked this flow).
critical_code_review_comments: BookSlot.jsx (final review): bookableShifts memo (L72-82) correctly dedupes by start_time and filters is_full/is_past/available — good defensive coding against dirty seed data. Shift card UI (L224-258) shows both 'X/Y booked' and 'X booked so far' variants based on max_bookings — clean. Payload (L90-102) sends start_time = selectedTime (which is shift.start_time), matching backend expectation.

BookingDetail.jsx: rescheduleShifts memo (L125-134) mirrors the same dedupe/filter logic — good consistency. CheckCircle2 icon import added (L21). The reschedule modal uses the same shift-card metaphor which keeps the mental model consistent for the user.

Minor UX polish (non-blocking): the shift card text 'X booked so far · Token assigned on confirmation' is a bit long on small viewports and wraps below the checkmark — consider a two-line layout with the meta text on a smaller line, or shorten to just 'X booked · Token on confirm'.
No hardcoded URLs seen; both files use `api` client which resolves REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All interactive elements have data-testid. i18n keys are used consistently.
